_comment: Performance baseline for the CI REGRESSION gate (plan 6.2). Re-based 2026-08-14 (second calibration) after CI run 31746968868: the shared windows-latest runner under Defender measures ~940 rec/s for batched 100k inserts vs ~5 300 rec/s on a dev machine (~5.7x slower). Values are CI-runner budgets with headroom; the relative check fails only when a metric regresses >25% below these budgets. Absolute catastrophe gates live in the bench binaries. Metrics below 5 ms are exempt from the relative check: their absolute GATE already fails the bench, and relative comparison on sub-5 ms values is pure noise.
